RESOLUTION PATH, corrected 2026-09-14 after session 08: :postId is an indexer FEED ITEM id, so the item is read first (bounded scan of the public feed — there is no /api/v1/social/feed/{id}) and a token is resolved only from the SYMBOL the row names in metadata.token_out / token_in, a feed row carrying no token_id. PARTIAL because that endpoint and /api/v1/social/feed/{id}/comments are both unregistered, so the thread renders a named unavailable state, and a row naming no token draws the token surface unavailable rather than guessing one.
